title: DNA Methylation and Vascular Function
official: DNA Methylation and Vascular Function in Obesity: Role of Exercise and Weight Loss
summary: The main objective is to examine DNA hypomethylation as an underlying mechanism for the increased production of inflammatory cytokines and the impaired vascular function in obese individuals and as a potential target for nonpharmacological preventive/therapeutic interventions such as aerobic exercise.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* BMI ≥ 35 kg/m2
* Between ages 18-50 years
* Not pregnant
* Approved for a bariatric surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* To avoid confounding from other inflammatory conditions individuals with current cancer, heart, kidney or liver disease, gallbladder disease or acute or chronic inflammatory diseases (including rheumatoid arthritis, lupus and other autoimmune diseases and genetic diseases) will be excluded
* Pregnant women will be excluded, as they will not be eligible for bariatric surgery
* Current smokers
* Currently abusing alcohol or drugs
